risk_note: RV2 payout admin reads (FU-WITHDRAWALS-USER-LOOKUP, contract CT-24zzb #2849; rulings D10-1042, orchestrator 18:53). listAdminWithdrawals and getAdminWithdrawal now accept user.lookup: the guard's point list keeps user.lookup only when user_id is present (and, on the list, no risk_flag), so a missing user_id or a risk_flag gets the guard's own 10403 without reading. For an account with user.lookup but neither withdraw.review nor fund.view, reject_note and auto_decision are null, risk_flags is [] and holds[].source_ref is null, blanked once in the view; a non-super actor without permissions is treated the same (rather too little than too much). On the detail, a user_id of another user is the same 20001 [withdrawal_id] as an unknown id, a non-UUID user_id is 20001 [user_id]. AdminActor gains an optional read-only permissions, handed over only when the operation sets withPermissions (always handing it over would turn the frozen guard-mount exact actor comparisons red); it never decides who is let in. No write operation gains user.lookup; no amount, status or ledger is touched. Integration lookup + frozen admin-withdrawals + guard directories 98/98. A separate run with spec/admin/auth had 3 boot timeouts plus one follow-on assertion under load; those three files run alone 39/39.
